texts.zh:
在[From.GetName]所发现的独特晶体具有相当特殊的性质。[Root.GetName]船员们报告称在他们到达该星球表面时内心格外的镇定，他们神清气爽、情绪高昂并一直持续到返回轨道。显然，这种晶体能在一种医学上已知对[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]健康有益的频率上发生共振。

如果我们有一天在[From.GetName]建立了殖民地，我们的人民绝对会享受在这种共振晶体附近的生活。
texts.en:
The unique crystals found on [From.GetName] possess quite exceptional properties. The [Root.GetName] crew reports to have found their visit to the planet's surface entirely soothing, leaving them refreshed and placated upon return to orbit. Apparently, the crystals resonate at a frequency known to be medically therapeutic for [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural].

If ever we were to settle on [From.GetName], our populace would surely enjoy living in constant proximity to these resonant minerals.

summary.text:
# 共鸣水晶 / Resonant Crystals

- 分类 Category：深空异闻 Exploration · DLC：《遥远繁星》Distant Stars（has_distar） · 审阅 Reviewed：2026-10-12（已审阅 reviewed）
- 来源 Sources：common/anomalies/95_anomaly_categories_distant_stars.txt:358-378; events/distant_stars_events_1.txt:3840 (distar.95)

## 如何开始 How it starts

需要《遥远繁星》。宜居星球可能生成（1级，权重1）；格式塔帝国不会遇到（它们会遇到对应的“高强磁性”）。

Requires Distant Stars. Can spawn on habitable planets (level 1, weight 1); gestalt empires never get it (they get the parallel "Attractive Magnetism").

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

distar.95“抚慰共鸣”：星球地壳的水晶以对本物种有疗愈作用的频率共振，登陆船员回到轨道后神清气爽。星球获得 soothing_crystals 修正，记录标本 vibrating_crystal。

distar.95 "Soothing Resonance": the crust's crystals resonate at a frequency therapeutic for our species; the landing crew came back refreshed. The planet gains soothing_crystals; specimen vibrating_crystal.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

唯一结果，无随机分支。

Single outcome; no random branch.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

无文明差异的选项。

No empire-specific option differences.
